Trace, implement and test: Nth Largest

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Main {
    public static int NthLargest(int arr[],int n, int k)
    {
        for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++)
        {
            for(int j=0;j<n-i-1;j++)
            {
                if (arr[j] > arr[j+1])
                {
                    int temp = arr[j];
                    arr[j] = arr[j+1];
                    arr[j+1] = temp;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return arr[n-k];
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = 5;
        int k = 3;
        int arr[] = {11, -1, -4, 12, -6}; // -6 -4 -1 11 12
       int ans =  NthLargest(arr, n, k);
       System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
